Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - FCC Reporting

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Compliance team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Regulatory FinCrime Compliance domain!

Our data mission is to enable effective risk detection, monitoring and regulatory compliance through robust data models, scalable analytics and high quality reporting.

The team works closely with Compliance, Risk and Product to design and implement data-driven controls, detection mechanisms, and investigative tools across multiple jurisdictions.

Projects range from building curated data models to cover global key risk indicators for financial crime compliance and automating into standardised board packs, to scaling our regulatory reporting engine to incorporate datasets specific to transaction monitoring, screening and client KYC.

As part of the team you will


Design and maintain data models and datasets used for transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and financial crime investigations.
Own end-to-end delivery of FinCrime analytics solutions: requirements gathering, data extraction, transformation, validation, and deployment.
Develop and optimise detection logic and monitoring rules (e.g. transaction monitoring scenarios, anomaly detection, behavioural patterns).
Perform data quality checks and controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, and auditability of FinCrime datasets.
Build dashboards and analytical tools (Looker / Looker Studio or similar) for monitoring risk exposure, alerts, and investigation pipelines.
Support regulatory and internal audits, providing traceability of data, methodologies, and controls.
Contribute to the automation and continuous improvement of FinCrime processes (screening, monitoring, alert handling).


What We’re Looking For


2-5 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – preferably within FinCrime, Compliance, Risk, or Financial Services.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools is a plus: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker / Looker Studio, Git.
Experience building data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Solid understanding of financial crime frameworks.
Experience working with Python is desirable.
Knowledge of payment flows, FX, or banking products is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking with focus on data quality, controls, and risk interpretation.
Experience working with transaction monitoring systems or alerting frameworks is a plus.
Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into data logic.
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury Offers You


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment (hybrid model, 4 days office / 1 day remote)
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Málaga public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Title: Global Data Analyst
Description:
The Global Data and Technology team is looking for a candidate for the position of Global Data Analyst. We are looking for a Data Analyst. You will be situated within the product team, the data Engineering team, and working closely with the strategic Media Planning & client experience team. You will deliver Products across multiple regions and clients and support local markets across global initiatives, for optimal cross pollination and maximising the integrated connections between practice and product.

Mission & Responsibilities


Provides the product team with a technical expertise applied to data and solutions.
Automate daily tasks with technical scripting languages.
Translate complex data analysis into clear product logic, insights, and decisions.
Develop media budget allocation tools with deep understanding of reach curves, and scenario modelling.
Perform data analysis to evaluate product outputs.
Partner with data scientists who design and build algorithms, providing analytical framing, validation, and media context.
Use AI‑enabled tools to explore, test, and improve product features and decision frameworks.


Soft Skills & Competencies


5+years of experience in data analysis, ideally within media, advertising, marketing analytics, or related domains.
Strong understanding of media metrics, reach curve analysis, and budget optimisation concepts.
Hands‑on experience with analytical tools (e.g. SQL, Python, R, BI tools).
Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.
Loves problem solving.
Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst with a curious mindset and a strong appreciation for the power of accurate data to join our Madrid-based Data & Analytics team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team in the leading provider of professionally monitored alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe & LatAm.

Over the past years, Verisure has experienced exceptional and resilient growth, supported by continuous innovation, a sophisticated go-to-market model, and strong expansion across Europe and Latin America. Our Data & Analytics function plays a critical role in enabling this growth by turning data into actionable insights that drive better decision-making across the business.

The company’s success depends on its people, and it invests in them every day. Working with Verisure means being part of an industry-leading, world-class company with a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

What You’ll Do

Drive insights that matter

Cut through complexity to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Translate business challenges into sharp insights and actionable recommendations that influence real decisions across commercial, operational, customer and financial functions.

Deliver reporting that drives action

Own and evolve dashboards that don’t just inform—but guide. Ensure KPIs are meaningful, trusted, and aligned with business goals, while continuously raising the bar on how performance is tracked and understood.

Partner with the business

Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, challenging assumptions and shaping decisions. Communicate insights with clarity and impact, becoming a go-to partner for performance questions.

Strengthen data foundations

Champion data quality and consistency across sources. Collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Science to improve reliability and build a stronger, more scalable data environment.

About You

You bring a strong analytical mindset, paired with natural curiosity and a proactive approach. You’re not afraid to explore beyond the obvious, ask questions, and uncover insights that others might miss. At the same time, you thrive in a flexible, fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve, and you’re comfortable adapting while keeping quality high.


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
A couple of years of experience in Business Intelligence or Analytics
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
Knowledge of data modelling and KPI design
Advanced Excel skills
Professional level of English


Apply today!

Verisure Innovation is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds.

If you have questions regarding this role, please reach out to Charlotta Rydström, Group Talent Acquisition Lead, charlotta.rydstrom@verisure.com

The Company

We Are People Who Protect People

We are the leading provider of professionally monitored alarms for residential households and small businesses in Europe.

Peace of mind for families and small businesses

We believe it is a human right to feel safe and secure. We now protect more than 3.4 million families and small businesses. Our service includes 24/7 monitoring, expert verification and response, customer care, service and maintenance services, and professional technical support. As well as protecting against intrusion, weprotect against fire, attack, theft, life-threatening emergencies and other hazards. Verisure people are dedicatedand committed and provide what we believe is the best customer service in the industry.

Leading across a broad footprint

We are the leading provider of residential and small business monitored alarms in Europe. We operate in 17countries across Europe and Latin America. Our business is driven by organic growth, based on our differentiated business model. We attract high quality customers. We work hard to ensure that our customers are happy. This contributes to an industry leading level of attrition and a long customer lifetime.

A Technology-enabled Human Services Company

Our ~29,000 team-mates are the foundation of our company. Our business model combines technology and humanexpertise to protect people. We are a human services company. More than 80% of our colleagues interact withcustomers every day. This connection provides the insight that inspires our innovation. These insights are a sourceof advantage. We leverage these insights with the significant investment we make into product and service innovation. The close customer contact also fuels the pride which drives engagement.

30 Years Of Experience – And Many More To Come

We have been protecting what matters most since 1988. Over that time, we have expanded beyond our roots in the Nordics and Spain. We now serve most of Europe and have also established a strong presence in Latin America. In 2019, we formed a strategic partnership with Arlo, a world leader in connected cameras. Verisure acquired all rights to Arlo’s European business. This allows us to offer connected camera services in Europe as a complement to our professionally monitored security service. It also allows us to access new go-to-market opportunities in retail and e-commerce.

Read more: www.verisure.com

Title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Workload 80 - 100%

The role is designed to:


Support early-stage ideation initiatives and existing product teams.
Generate insights from usage data and customer behavior.
Focus on exploratory analysis, identifying meaningful product and usage metrics.
Develop indicators for evidence-based product decisions.
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ensure actionable insights.



What will you do


Analyze usage data and customer behavior to generate insights during early‑stage ideation
Support discovery and experimentation with exploratory analyses and rapid insights
Define and evolve product and usage metrics that indicate success and value
Work closely with product managers to translate questions and hypotheses into analyses
Advise engineering teams on where and how data should be collected within applications
Automate relevant metrics and analyses as products mature
Take analytical ownership for products emerging from ideation initiatives
Stay current with modern analytics techniques and AI‑enabled analytical approaches



What You Bring & Who You Are


Strong experience in data analysis, analytics, or a similar hands‑on role
Excellent analytical thinking and ability to turn data into clear insights
Proficiency with common analytics tools and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, BI tools)
Experience working with product, usage, or behavioral data
Proven interest in AI‑enabled products and modern analytical approaches
Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn and experiment
Comfortable working in early‑stage, exploratory environments
Strong communication skills with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
Fluent in English; German is a plus



Benefits:

At our company, we strive to create a culture of continuous learning, personal growth, and inter- national community involvement. We're passionate about providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed, and we're confident that you'll love being part of our team!


Working Hours We offer flexible working hours to accommodate your work schedule. 60% on remote and 40% at our offices in Madrid, Torre Europa.
Meal allowances



You can enjoy delicious meals on us, no matter if you are working remotely or on-site.


Option to use it for public transportation or childcare instead.
Internet Compensation We cover the cost of your home internet connection, as we understand how essential connectivity is in the modern workplace.
Training courses Our company is committed to helping our employees grow and develop their skills, which is why we offer a variety of industry- specific training courses and a learning channel.
Gym Coverage Stay active and healthy with our 90% coverage benefit, which provides access to the nearby gym: Forus Selection to keep you energized throughout the day
Health Insurance We take the health and well-being of our employees seriously, which is why we offer a comprehensive health insurance plan and the option to extend it to your spouse and children.

We are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruiting process and workplace for everyone.

Title: Data Analyst (Remote)
Description:
Role: Data Analyst (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Subject Matter Expert – Data & Statistical Chart Analysis (AI Benchmark) to work on a full time basis. The role involves evaluating and interpreting statistical data and visual representations to assess AI performance benchmarks across diverse models and datasets. You will analyze trends, anomalies, and correlations to ensure accuracy and reliability in benchmarking results.




Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate and interpret statistical data and visual representations to assess AI performance benchmarks

• Analyze trends, anomalies, and correlations in AI benchmarking datasets

• Validate data integrity and consistency across benchmarking reports

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine benchmarking methodologies

• Document findings and present insights to stakeholders




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience in data analysis with a focus on statistical methodologies

• Proficiency in interpreting complex charts, graphs, and statistical reports

• Familiarity with AI model performance metrics and benchmarking frameworks

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the advancement of AI benchmarking standards. The position requires meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards in data analysis.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.
Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.
Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.


Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Title: Social Listening - Data Analyst
Description:
About SAMY

We weren't built to follow, we were built to lead.

SAMY is the global powerhouse redefining brand communication for a social-first world—helping brands stay relevant, shape culture, and build real connections at the speed the world moves.

Since 2013, we've grown from a bold idea into a global force: 1,200+ experts, 17+ offices, 55 markets, 22+ countries. We launch 40+ campaigns a week, create one piece of content every minute, and generate +$500K in revenue every day.

We are Path Finders: curious, ambitious, and never afraid to challenge what’s next.

We don't play it safe. We build what's next.

Link instagram, tiktok, cultura.

Role Mission

As a Social Listening - Data Analyst at SAMY, you’ll transform campaign and business data into clear, actionable insights that help teams and clients make better decisions and improve performance.

New project coming!

Join the team behind one of the world's most iconic beauty portfolios and help define how global brands win in today's creator economy.

Beauty is one of the fastest-moving and most influential industries in the world. Trends are born overnight, creators shape consumer behaviour, and communities decide what products become tomorrow's icons. Working on this account means having a front-row seat to everything happening across social, culture, creators and innovation.

At SAMY, you'll help global beauty brands stay ahead of what's next. You'll turn cultural shifts into strategy, identify the creators driving conversations, and build advocacy programmes that connect brands with millions of people in authentic ways.

You'll work at the intersection of social, culture, AI, technology and creativity, where every day brings new trends, new platforms and new opportunities to shape the future of beauty marketing.

If you're passionate about creators, obsessed with culture and excited by the idea of working on one of the most prestigious global beauty accounts in the industry, we'd love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze campaign and business performance data to identify trends, patterns, drivers, and optimization opportunities.
Utilize tools like Sprinklr and Brandwatch to gather consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
Develop and maintain benchmarks, KPIs, and measurement frameworks aligned with client and business objectives.
Prepare regular and ad-hoc performance reports, turning data into compelling and easy-to-understand narratives.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance through data-driven recommendations.
Collaborate with Strategy, Creative, Account, and other teams to ensure data informs decision-making.
Contribute to improving reporting methodologies, analytical processes, and data storytelling standards.


,

Skills & Experience


Experience in data analysis, digital marketing analytics, or a similar role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
Ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Understanding of digital marketing, social media, and campaign performance metrics.
Strong communication skills and ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive, curious, and solution-oriented mindset.
English full working proficiency (written and verbal).


Benefits


Work your way – Flexible schedule, hybrid work, and the opportunity to work up to 3 weeks a year from any SAMY office around the world.
Time that matters – Celebrate your birthday with a day off, plus company holidays on December 24th and 31st to recharge.
Grow with us – Global mobility opportunities, mentorship, parenthood support, and a transparent performance-driven compensation framework.
Be part of the journey – – Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.


The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder?

Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We’re not looking for people who think the same, we’re looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Be Kind — because respect, trust, and honest feedback make great teams stronger.

Go Beyond — because good is never enough when excellence is the standard.

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

Own It — because real impact starts with accountability.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

Title: Manager Data Intelligence
Description:
Company Description

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description


Collects, validates, and maintains data from internal and external sources to support feasibility and operational activities.
Analyses clinical trial, site, investigator, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Develops and maintains standard reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to support stakeholder decision-making.
Supports feasibility assessments by providing data summaries, analyses, and insights related to study requirements, site performance, recruitment trends, and therapeutic areas.
Collaborates with Operational Strategy, Clinical Operations, Business Development, and other functional stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver timely analyses.
Performs data quality reviews and works to resolve data inconsistencies and gaps.
Identifies opportunities to improve existing data collection, reporting, and analytical processes.
Supports the evaluation and integration of new data sources, tools, and technologies.
Maintains documentation related to data sources, methodologies, reporting processes, and best practices.
Develops and updates reporting templates and analytical tools to improve efficiency and consistency.
Provides ad hoc analyses and reports in support of departmental and organizational priorities.
Monitors key operational and feasibility metrics and communicates findings to stakeholders.
Supports process improvement initiatives by leveraging data to identify efficiencies and operational enhancements.
Ensures compliance with applicable quality standards, policies, and data governance requirements.
Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, Business, Statistics, Public Health, or a related field required. Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred.
Strong experience in clinical research, feasibility, clinical operations, data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Experience working with clinical trial, investigator, site, operational, or healthcare-related datasets.
Demonstrated experience analysing and interpreting complex data from multiple sources.
Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations for business stakeholders.
Experience working within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or related environment preferred.
Experience supporting feasibility assessments, site selection activities, clinical operations, or operational planning preferred.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a global environment.
Knowledge of clinical development processes and clinical trial conduct is desirable.
Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, or similar platforms preferred.


Additional Information

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.


Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.


We look forward to welcoming your application.

Impulsar iniciativas de mejora continua basadas en datos

Title: Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Si para ti un dato no es solo un número en una celda, sino el inicio de una historia que puede cambiar el rumbo de un negocio, tenemos que hablar.

En WAM sabemos que tener la mejor infraestructura de datos no sirve de nada si nadie sabe interpretarla. Buscamos a un/a Marketing Data Analyst que sea la pieza clave que conecte el trabajo técnico con las decisiones estratégicas de nuestros clientes.

Bajo el liderazgo del Data Lead, y trabajando codo con codo con Data Engineering, serás la persona encargada de transformar datos complejos en insights accionables, cuadros de mando interactivos y conclusiones de negocio brillantes.

Tu misión será convertir la complejidad del dato en claridad estratégica. Diseñarás dashboards avanzados y modelos analíticos que aporten luz a los clientes, demostrando el ROI y apoyando el crecimiento transversal de nuestros estudios a través de la evidencia innegable del dato.

Lo Que Harás (de Verdad)

Análisis 360º del Negocio:


Desarrollar modelos analíticos que permitan analizar el impacto de cada canal de marketing durante todo el ciclo de vida digital del cliente.
Estandarizar la estrategia de analítica y reporting unificando la metodología a nivel compañía y facilitando el discurso de las distintas áreas de marketing y ventas.
Realizar análisis tanto globales de negocio como por área (adquisición, conversión, retención o loyalty).
Ser capaz de integrar y analizar datos de canales offline y online para facilitar la toma de decisiones de negocio.


Visualización De Datos


Diseñar, evolucionar y mantener cuadros de mando interactivos en herramientas líderes (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) que permitan identificar oportunidades de negocio, detectar tendencias y facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Asegurar que la capa visual sea intuitiva, accionable y cuente la historia correcta.


Implementación Técnica


Ser capaz de definir junto con los equipos de estrategia la implementación necesaria para garantizar una correcta captación del dato para posteriormente convertirlo en reportes para el cliente.
Coordinar junto al equipo técnico la implementación técnica en las distintas plataformas del cliente (eCommerce, Web, App, etc).


Consultoría y Calidad


Asesorar a dirección y equipos de Creatividad, Marketing y Ventas en la toma de decisiones basadas en datos para impulsar el crecimiento y eficiencia de nuestros clientes.
Apoyar al Data Lead en la interpretación de los datos para reuniones ejecutivas, traduciendo la complejidad técnica en recomendaciones estratégicas claras para el cliente.
Trabajarás de la mano con el Data Engineer para asegurar la calidad y veracidad absoluta de los datos.
Documentar la lógica de negocio y mantener el glosario de KPIs de cada proyecto.


Crecemos Contigo, Cuidamos De Ti


Horario flexible: Conciliación de tu vida personal y profesional.
Modelo híbrido: Nos gusta vernos 1-2 días a la semana en la oficina, pero siempre con máxima flexibilidad.
Salario: entre 34K - 40K € brutos anuales, dependiendo de tu experiencia.
Días especiales: Día libre en tu cumpleaños y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Plan de Igualdad: Entorno inclusivo, respetuoso y con oportunidades justas para todas las personas.
Retribución Flexible: Accede a nuestro plan con Cobee.
Desarrollo profesional: Plan de desarrollo adaptado a tu perfil e inquietudes.
Jornada intensiva: Viernes hasta las 15:00h. Además en verano (22/06 al 11/09) y Navidad (desde el 21/12 al 8/01) trabajamos de 8 a 15.


Imprescindible (si No Lo Tienes, No Es Tu Rol)


Formación en Data e IA.
Experiencia Analítica: Al menos 2-3 años de experiencia real en un rol de Marketing Data Analyst, BI Analyst o similar, preferiblemente en ecosistemas digitales o consultoras.
Dominio de GA4, Google Tag Manager y herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau o Looker.
Mentalidad de Negocio: Capacidad demostrable para calcular y entender métricas clave de negocio (ROI, LTV, CAC, Tasa de Conversión, Engagement, etc) relacionadas con áreas como Marketing Automation, Paid Media, UX/UI o SEO entre otros.
Experiencia en analítica para eCommerce B2C y B2B de al menos 2 años.
Comunicación: Tienes que saber explicar un dashboard complejo a alguien que no sabe de datos.
Idiomas: Inglés nivel B2/C1 (necesario para manejar documentación técnica y presentar a clientes internacionales).


Nice to have


Experiencia en análisis avanzados con modelos de atribución y modelos predictivos.
Experiencia en A/B testing.
Experiencia con el ecosistema Salesforce (Marketing Cloud) y su modelo de datos.


Con nuestro talento y experiencia, llevamos la transformación organizacional a otro nivel, preparándo a las empresas para liderar el futuro.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate! 🚀

Title: Global Data Analyst
Description:
The Global Data and Technology team is looking for a candidate for the position of Global Data Analyst. We are looking for a Data Analyst. You will be situated within the product team, the data Engineering team, and working closely with the strategic Media Planning & client experience team. You will deliver Products across multiple regions and clients and support local markets across global initiatives, for optimal cross pollination and maximising the integrated connections between practice and product.

Mission & Responsibilities


Provides the product team with a technical expertise applied to data and solutions.
Automate daily tasks with technical scripting languages.
Translate complex data analysis into clear product logic, insights, and decisions.
Develop media budget allocation tools with deep understanding of reach curves, and scenario modelling.
Perform data analysis to evaluate product outputs.
Partner with data scientists who design and build algorithms, providing analytical framing, validation, and media context.
Use AI‑enabled tools to explore, test, and improve product features and decision frameworks.


Soft Skills & Competencies


5+years of experience in data analysis, ideally within media, advertising, marketing analytics, or related domains.
Strong understanding of media metrics, reach curve analysis, and budget optimisation concepts.
Hands‑on experience with analytical tools (e.g. SQL, Python, R, BI tools).
Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.
Loves problem solving.
Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Formar parte de Aire es unirte a una compañía tecnológica ágil e innovadora. Tenemos el propósito de impulsar a nuestros clientes B2B para que hagan crecer su negocio.

Ofrecemos soluciones avanzadas de Cloud, telecomunicaciones, UCaaS, ciberseguridad y servicios gestionados para empresas, con un modelo centrado en pymes, corporaciones, administraciones públicas y operadores de telecomunicaciones en España y Portugal.

Nos diferenciamos por desarrollar soluciones tecnológicas propias, buscando la excelencia y la cercanía con nuestros clientes. Para ello apostamos por el talento como motor de este proyecto.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

El analista senior de datos, deberá reforzar el equipo de BI aportando un alto nivel técnico en el desarrollo y evolución del ecosistema de datos de negocio y en la generación de informes para dirección y otras áreas, garantizando el cumplimiento de los entregables. Es una posición con un fuerte componente de automatización: se espera que lidere técnicamente la transformación de procesos manuales en procesos automatizados y repetibles, incorporando soluciones de automatización avanzada (incluida la IA) allí donde aporten eficiencia.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?


Trabajar sobre las tablas y el modelo del ecosistema de datos de negocio, colaborando con el equipo en su evolución y mantenimiento.
Construir, mantener y evolucionar informes y cuadros de mando en Power BI y Excel para dirección y otras áreas de negocio.
Interactuar con la capa directiva y con responsables de otras áreas para recoger, entender y priorizar sus necesidades de información.
Garantizar la entrega de los informes y análisis en plazo, recurriendo a soluciones manuales cuando sea necesario para no comprometer el entregable.
Liderar de forma proactiva la automatización de procesos: una vez resuelta la primera entrega, es responsabilidad clave del puesto rediseñar y automatizar el proceso (scripts, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización e IA cuando aporten valor) para que las siguientes ejecuciones no requieran intervención manual.
Identificar de forma proactiva procesos manuales o repetitivos del equipo susceptibles de automatización, y proponer e implementar soluciones.
Apoyar y coordinarse con el resto del equipo (ETL/Python y Power BI) para repartir y sacar adelante la carga de trabajo mensual.


¿Qué requisitos necesitamos?


Entre 4 y 5 años de experiencia en Business Intelligence, analítica de datos o similar.
Nivel avanzado de SQL y MySQL.
Nivel medio de Python.
Nivel avanzado de Power BI (modelado de datos y DAX).
Nivel avanzado de Excel.
Inglés nivel medio (uso ocasional, no intensivo).
Capacidad de interlocución con dirección y con responsables de otras áreas.
Experiencia demostrable automatizando procesos de datos e informes (scripting, programación de tareas, herramientas de automatización).


¿Qué valoramos?


Conocimiento o experiencia aplicando IA para la automatización de procesos (por ejemplo, generación de scripts, agentes o herramientas de IA aplicadas a tareas repetitivas).
Experiencia previa liderando o coordinando equipos.
Experiencia en el sector de las telecomunicaciones (Telco).


¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?


Contrato indefinido y jornada completa.
Modalidad de trabajo híbrido
Flexibilidad de entrada
Jornada intensiva durante los meses de verano
23 días hábiles de vacaciones anuales para que te desconectes y recargues energías
¡No te pierdas nada con nuestro Campus Aire University! Accede a toda la formación disponible y revisa las formaciones pasadas para impulsar tu carrera en telecomunicaciones y cloud
Acceso a descuentos del Club Aire, con ofertas increíbles en moda, viajes, entretenimiento, hostelería, motor y electrónica. ¡Aprovecha!
¡Muy buen ambiente de trabajo!


En Aire, creemos firmemente que los equipos diversos e inclusivos impulsan la innovación, la transformación y mejores resultados. Por ello, promovemos y garantizamos la inclusión de todas las personas, sin importar su género, edad, orientación e identidad sexual, cultura, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal. Nuestro compromiso es construir un entorno donde cada persona pueda aportar su talento y crecer profesionalmente.

En Aire, la igualdad nos une, la diversidad nos fortalece.

Title: Procurement Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Workload: 100%

Join us in Madrid as a Procurement Data Analyst and help turn procurement data into clear insights and reliable reporting. You'll work with SAP Ariba, Sievo Spend Analytics, and AI procurement tools to support smarter decisions. We welcome your unique perspective.

What you will do:


Collect, clean, validate, and analyse procurement data from multiple sources
Create recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and analyses for procurement stakeholders
Support savings reporting methodology, tracking, and validation of reported figures
Ensure data quality, reconcile figures, and help resolve issues in reporting outputs
Work with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into analytical outputs
Support testing and user adoption activities for reporting and analytics solutions



What you bring & who you are:


A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field
2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or business analytics
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with data analysis tools
Strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and confidence working with stakeholders
Experience with Excel and ideally Power BI or a similar visualisation tool
Ideally, experience in procurement, supply chain, or finance, plus knowledge of Databricks or data modelling
Proficient in English, German is a plus



Even if you don't meet every point, we look forward to your application.

About the team: Our Procurement Analytics team turns data into decisions that matter. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and value every perspective. Backgrounds and experiences differ — curiosity and collaboration unite us.

Benefits:

At our company, we strive to create a culture of continuous learning, personal growth, and inter- national community involvement. We're passionate about providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed, and we're confident that you'll love being part of our team!


Working Hours We offer flexible working hours to accommodate your work schedule. We can work part of our time remotely and the rest at our offices in Madrid, Torre Europa.
Meal allowances



You can enjoy delicious meals on us, no matter if you are working remotely or on-site.


Option to use it for public transportation or childcare instead.
Internet Compensation We cover the cost of your home internet connection, as we understand how essential connectivity is in the modern workplace.
Training courses Our company is committed to helping our employees grow and develop their skills, which is why we offer a variety of industry- specific training courses and a learning channel.
Gym Coverage Stay active and healthy with our 90% coverage benefit, which provides access to the nearby gym: Forus Selection to keep you energized throughout the day
Health Insurance We take the health and well-being of our employees seriously, which is why we offer a comprehensive health insurance plan and the option to extend it to your spouse and children.



At Axpo Group, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of non-discrimination, tolerance, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications regardless of race and ethnicity, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, as well as socioeconomic, cultural, and religious background. We are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruiting process and workplace for everyone.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.
Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.
Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.


Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Title: Sr Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business Analyst

Location: Madrid, Spain

Working Pattern: Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

At PMI, we're transforming our business and building our future around one clear purpose: delivering a smoke-free future.

As part of our Data, Insights & Analytics (DI&A) team, you'll help turn data into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions and drive meaningful impact across the organization.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge business strategy and analytics by translating complex business challenges into data-driven insights and solutions.

Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will identify opportunities, uncover trends, develop dashboards and analytical products, and enable better, faster, and more informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze commercial, consumer, and digital data to identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and define analytical requirements.
Design, build, and enhance dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
Extract, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Translate complex findings into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
Drive visibility of key performance indicators across multiple functions.
Support continuous improvement through experimentation, performance measurement, and insight generation.
Promote data quality, analytics adoption, and evidence-based decision-making.


What We're Looking For

Must Have


4+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or related fields.
Advanced Power BI expertise, including dashboard development and data modelling.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Knowledge of Snowflake, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar cloud-based analytics environments.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
Experience translating business questions into analytical solutions and actionable recommendations.
Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Advanced English communication skills.


Nice to Have


Experience working with consumer, CRM, loyalty, or customer lifecycle data.
Understanding of consumer behavior from acquisition to retention.
Experience with advanced or predictive analytics using Python, R, or similar programming languages.


Why PMI?

At PMI, you'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues from around the world, and contribute to the transformation of a global organization.

We offer the opportunity to learn, innovate, grow your career, and make an impact from day one.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We believe diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Relocation support and visa sponsorship are not provided. Candidates must have the legal right to work in Spain to be considered for this role.

Title: Workday Reporting Data Analyst - Full remote Spain or Portugal
Description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Workday Reporting Data Analyst - Full remote Spain or Portugal

We’re looking for a Workday Reporting Data Analyst to transform HR data into reliable reporting, meaningful metrics, and actionable insights. This role is central to maintaining data integrity, improving reporting quality, and helping Colleague Resources teams make informed decisions across global operations.

You’ll design and maintain Workday reports, analyse complex HR datasets, support system administration and releases, and translate business needs into practical reporting solutions. Working with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business stakeholders, you’ll combine technical expertise with a strong understanding of HR processes.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Workday reports ranging from simple operational reports to matrix, trended, and composite reports.
Deliver meaningful HR metrics, trends, dashboards, charts, and analytical insights to support Colleague Resources operations and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into clear, scalable, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, data discrepancies, improvement opportunities, and areas for partnership with internal stakeholders.
Support HRIS administration through group data updates, imports, exports, data clean-up, and investigation of data quality issues.
Contribute to Workday releases, upgrades, implementations, and functional testing, ensuring reporting continuity and process quality.
Act as a liaison between HRIS and functional teams, combining system knowledge with an understanding of HR processes and business priorities.
Coordinate reporting guidance and training, and respond to stakeholder questions in a clear and practical way.
Engage with the Workday Community, monitor relevant developments, and share useful insights with Colleague Resources leadership.
Ensure reporting and data-handling activities align with security, privacy, and data governance standards.


The skills you will have when you apply


Strong Workday reporting experience – hands-on experience creating and maintaining custom reports, including matrix, trended, and composite reports, using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting functionality.
Data analytics capability – experience analysing complex datasets, identifying trends and discrepancies, and presenting meaningful metrics and insights; knowledge of data mining, operational analytics, data models, and SQL is preferred.
HRIS and systems understanding – strong knowledge of Workday administration, data integrity, reporting processes, and HR systems, with the ability to support testing, releases, and process improvements.
Advanced Microsoft tools – strong Excel capability, including formulas and macros, together with proficiency in PowerPoint and Visio.
Business analysis and problem-solving – able to translate requirements into functional solutions, investigate issues, identify root causes, and recommend sustainable improvements.
Clear communication and stakeholder partnership – able to explain data and technical topics in a simple, practical way, deliver presentations, coordinate training, and build effective relationships with HRIS, HR, IT, and business teams.
International collaboration and adaptability – comfortable working in a global, fast-moving environment, managing priorities, adapting to change, and contributing effectively within a team.


Experience and education


Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Five years of related experience, including three years working with database migration and/or integration and large-scale, complex datasets, with a focus on reporting and analytics, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in business operations or human resources is preferred, together with Workday administration, custom reporting, and troubleshooting experience.
A basic understanding of ServiceNow and case management is an advantage.


Working context


This role is fully remote and based in Spain or Portugal.
You will collaborate with international HRIS, Colleague Resources, IT, and business teams across countries and time zones.
You will help strengthen reporting standards, data quality, and the use of HR analytics to support better business decisions.


About Sedgwick

Sedgwick is the world’s leading risk and claims administration partner, helping clients thrive by navigating the unexpected. The company’s expertise, combined with advanced AI-enabled technology, supports solutions in claims administration, loss adjusting, benefits administration, and product recall.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. Our colleagues support people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate! 🚀

Title: Data Analyst Consultant
Description:
The team, position & mission:

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming business needs into data-driven solutions that support decision-making across the organization. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and central data teams, you will analyze requirements, develop analytics solutions, and ensure that data models, dashboards, and reporting tools deliver meaningful business value.




In this position, you will act as a bridge between business and technical teams, facilitating discussions, translating requirements into analytical solutions, and supporting projects from initial scoping through development, testing, and implementation. You will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize data processes and enhance reporting capabilities.




We value people who are proactive on every level, deliver exceptional results, work well with others, and make a clear impact on our clients and our business. If you love collaborating, learning, sharing your expertise, and being recognized for your achievements, you’ll fit right in with our team.







Your key areas of responsibility as Data Analyst Consultant:

Analyze business requirements and translate them into data and analytics solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models using Power BI and related tools.
Facilitate meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define priorities, and track actions.
Develop and optimize data models, queries, and data structures using SQL, Python, and data modeling best practices.
Support project planning, KPI definition, and the delivery of data initiatives aligned with business objectives.
Create and maintain documentation, presentations, and reporting standards.
Collaborate with business, IT, DPO, and central data teams to ensure data quality, compliance, and successful project delivery.
Identify opportunities to improve, automate, and accelerate data-related processes and reporting.







As an ideal candidate you have:

Experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar data-focused role.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports with Power BI.
Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling concepts.
Experience using Python for data analysis, automation, or reporting.
Ability to translate business requirements into analytical or technical solutions and communicate effectively with both business and IT stakeholders.
Strong organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent English and Spanish; French is considered a strong advantage.







It is not a requirement, but other preferred qualifications would be:

Experience with Power Apps.
Academic and/or professional experience in a biological, life sciences, or related domain.
Knowledge of Agile project delivery methodologies and business process improvement initiatives.







What we offer you:

Hybrid ways of working with access to our modern & collaborative office in Madrid. We are working fully remotely in July and August.
We may work with tomorrow’s technology, but at our core we are a people-oriented organization.
An open and inclusive culture, that enables us to reach our full potential.
A community of experts - as Digital Natives, we put innovation at the heart of our expertise.
Compelling advantages including an intensive work schedule in July and August, restaurant tickets, health insurance, trainings, certifications, flexible remuneration and many more.
Read more about the benefits we offer here.







About Orange Business:

Orange Business is the Orange Group entity dedicated to businesses and organizations. Our unique history as a telco operator and now an IT services company enables us to support the sustainable digital transformation of enterprise businesses worldwide.




We bring the rigor of a network and connectivity expert together with the agility of a global digital solutions integrator. We combine global presence with a local approach to get the most out of digital technology, from networks and cloud to data and service platforms.




Digital & Data is the dedicated Orange Business entity for professional services in digital and data, operating as part of the Orange Business European organization. We help enterprises design, build and deliver digital and data solutions, from consulting and advisory through to large-scale implementation and managed services, combining deep technical expertise with the operational agility of a ringfenced organization.




By pooling expertise across countries, we offer clients a consistent European delivery model, the ability to reuse proven capabilities at scale, and seamless integration with Orange Business' wider proposition in network, AI, trusted cloud and cybersecurity. This dedicated focus on professional services, backed by the strength and reach of Orange Business and the Orange Group, means our clients benefit from specialized digital and data expertise delivered with clear accountability, European coverage, and the assurance of a trusted long-term partner.







Apply now

We can’t wait to meet you!

Actualmente contamos con vacantes en Madrid y Bilbao para un/a Data Analyst con una fuerte orientación a Analytics Engineering para unirse a un equipo de datos en crecimiento y participar en la construcción de productos analíticos escalables y de alto impacto que quieran desarrollar su carrera profesional en GFT. Buscamos personas entusiastas, con iniciativa y ganas de seguir aprendiendo, que deseen crecer en un entorno multicultural, dinámico, colaborativo y lleno de retos.







Tus principales responsabilidades serán:







Aunque dependerán de tus conocimientos y experiencia aportada, en general las principales funciones que llevarías a cabo con nosotros serían:







Analizar las necesidades de información de las distintas áreas de negocio.
Diseñar datasets y capas analíticas orientadas al consumo y la explotación de datos.
Construir dashboards, informes y otros productos analíticos.
Definir KPIs y métricas en colaboración con los equipos de negocio.
Diseñar y establecer un framework común de reporting y visualización.
Construir, evolucionar y mantener el modelo semántico en Looker.
Asegurar la consistencia entre el Business Glossary, el modelo semántico y los diferentes productos analíticos.

Trabajar junto con los equipos de Data Governance en las definiciones semánticas y en la calidad de los datos.
Colaborar temporalmente con diferentes squads cuando se produzcan picos de demanda analítica.

Experiencia de 6 años o más en rol similar
Experiencia trabajando con SQL avanzado.
Experiencia con BigQuery.
Conocimientos sólidos de Looker, especialmente en la construcción y mantenimiento de modelos semánticos.
Experiencia en modelado dimensional y diseño de modelos semánticos.
Capacidad para definir KPIs, métricas y criterios de medición junto con las áreas de negocio.
Conocimientos de visualización de datos y buenas prácticas de reporting.

Capacidad para mantener una interlocución directa y efectiva con perfiles de negocio.
Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.

Trabajo en equipo
Habilidades de comunicación, favoreciendo dinámicas que permitan el flujo de conocimiento, con interés tanto en aprender como en enseñar.
Proactividad en la búsqueda de nuevas soluciones y mejoras
