Title: Analista de datos
Description:
¡En K-LAGAN te estamos esperando para continuar creciendo juntos! Somos una empresa estratégica internacional de servicios tecnológicos, comprometida esencialmente con su equipo y con la sociedad. Ofrecemos soluciones en servicios IT, desarrollos de ingeniería, de electrónica y proyectos de I+D.




En esta ocasión, buscamos incorporar a un/a Data Analyst (Power BI Expert) para un proyecto internacional y altamente estratégico dentro del sector seguros/asistencia.




🚀 Misión del puesto Como Data Analyst dentro del equipo central de plataforma de Datos e IA (Analytics Team), tu misión principal será transformar datos complejos en insights accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Serás una pieza clave dentro de la red de analistas de datos, actuando como referente en Power BI y Modelos Tabulares, impulsando la estandarización, la calidad del dato y el diseño de soluciones analíticas avanzadas a escala global.




📌 Responsabilidades principales

Desarrollo y Mejores Prácticas: Diseñar, implementar y mantener reportes/dashboards en Power BI, definiendo guías y estándares para modelado dimensional (Kimball, star schema), data marts y tecnologías asociadas (DAX, MDX, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Log Analytics/KQL).
Referente Técnico y Mentoring: Capacitar y dar soporte a los equipos de datos en el uso avanzado de Power BI, capacidades Premium/Embedded y Microsoft Fabric, actuando como experto ad-hoc para resolver flujos de datos y optimizar el rendimiento.
Evolución de la Plataforma BI: Contribuir al desarrollo e implantación del modelo de BI corporativo descentralizado y a la creación de sistemas analíticos avanzados en producción.
Comunidad de Datos (Guild): Participar activamente en la comunidad de analistas, fomentando la transferencia de conocimiento, la colaboración internacional y el crecimiento del ecosistema analítico.
Monitoreo y BAU: Supervisar actividades operativas, realizar tareas de mantenimiento/soporte (BAU) y generar informes sobre el rendimiento de la plataforma y la calidad de los datos.
Metodología Ágil: Trabajar en un entorno Agile (Scrum/Kanban) dentro de un equipo multicultural, traduciendo requisitos de negocio en soluciones técnicas claras (prototipos/mock-ups).




🎯 Requisitos

Experiencia: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en entornos Big Data (Build & Run) y analítica de datos, preferiblemente en organizaciones multinacionales.
Power BI & Visualización: Experiencia avanzada y sólida demostrable en Power BI, modelos tabulares, DAX, MDX y Azure Analysis Services. Valorable conocimiento en Power BI Premium/Embedded capacity y Microsoft Fabric.
SQL & Programación: Dominio experto de SQL. Valorable conocimientos en Python y PowerShell.
Data Warehousing & Cloud: Conocimiento sólido en principios de Business Intelligence, modelado dimensional (Kimball, esquemas en estrella), Data Warehouses y Data Marts. Valorable experiencia o familiaridad con Azure Cloud Datalake, Databricks, Spark o NoSQL.
Herramientas y Metodologías: Deseable conocimiento del ciclo de vida del software (Git, CI/CD con Azure DevOps) y metodologías Agile/Scrum.
Idiomas: Inglés fluido obligatorio (C1) para entorno de trabajo internacional diario. Francés muy valorable (o disposición a aprenderlo).
Perfil: Mentalidad proactiva, orientada al cliente, espíritu colaborativo y habilidades pedagógicas/mentoras. Valorable experiencia previa en el sector asegurador, financiero o de asistencia.




🌱 ¿Qué te ofrecemos en K-LAGAN?

Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable a largo plazo.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido en Barcelona.
Salario anual: 44.000 euros/aprox.
Horario flexible y conciliación.
Formación continua y plan de carrera personalizado.
Programa de reconocimiento 3 C’s (Compromiso, Comunicación y Orientación al Cliente).
Día libre por tu cumpleaños.
Seguro médico y plan de retribución flexible.
Descuento en gimnasio.
Ayudas en guarderías, idiomas y transporte (KM).
Día solidario anual.
Eventos de empresa: team building, cafés tecnológicos, afterworks, cena de verano y cena de Navidad.
A partir de 4 años de antigüedad, +1 día adicional de vacaciones.




Nuestro compromiso es contratar a los mejores talentos independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad o personas con otras capacidades, promoviendo siempre su desarrollo profesional y personal.

¿Crees que podría ser interesante para ti?

¡Apúntate o conecta con nosotros!

✅ YOUR GROWTH, OUR VISION

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking highly skilled technical Data Analysts for the Checkout team who are passionate about data, automation, analysis, and innovation, and who love working in a collaborative and agile environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Data Analyst in the Checkout team, you will be in charge of:


Build the infrastructure required for the extraction, transformation and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources.
Assemble large and complex datasets, with an optimal data pipeline architecture, meeting business requirements.
Implement processes to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes that depend on it.
Create alerts and dashboards to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs.
Identify, design and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimising queries, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
Collaborate with analytics and business teams to improve data models that feed existing reports or create brand new reports with the aim to increase data accessibility and foster data-driven decision making across the organisation.
Contribute to the delivery of strategic projects by participating in the delivery of key initiatives, giving support to the analytics and business teams when it comes to data availability and visualisation to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes. Work together with stakeholders in the execution of the projects.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
Experience building and optimising data pipelines, data sets and workflow management tools (e.g. Dataform).
Advance knowledge of SQL is a requirement as well as experience working with databases and large sets of data; Python programming skills are also required as well as experience in data visualisation or exploration tools such as Looker Studio.
An AI-first mindset — proactively exploring how AI tools can improve efficiency and quality of work.
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with Microsoft and Google Office packages (Excel, etc.).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
Strong organisational and communication skills.
Experience supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!
Business Proficiency in English.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops,tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Title: Senior Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Senior Fraud Data Analyst, you'll handle one of the most critical challenges in digital payments: keeping millions of transactions safe in real time.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimising the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimise the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalise machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.


Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.


Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Learn More About Us

Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here.

  • Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.

  • Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
  • Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
  • Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
  • Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
  • Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.

Title: Junior Data Analyst - Automation & Reporting
Description:
Everything you are looking for and more 📦

Join our Customer Care team at InPost Iberia as a Junior Data Analyst and become the bridge between raw data and business impact. Your mission: unlock the power of our data through automations that free up time for the team, dashboards that drive decisions, and a genuine curiosity to understand not just the "what" but the "why" behind every request.

What responsibilities and objectives will you have?


Design, build and maintain automations that reduce manual work for the Customer Care team and its agents, continuously improving them to maximize efficiency.
Automate the processing of recurring, business-critical files such as claims files, preparing them ready for review and minimizing human error.
Handle ad-hoc data requests: pulling lists, cross-referencing sources, running validations and delivering insights that support day-to-day decision-making.
Design, develop and maintain internal dashboards in Power BI that track KPIs and make data accessible across the team.
Contribute to Customer Care data tables and models, ensuring alignment with the standards set by the international data team.
Represent Customer Care Iberia in cross-functional company projects, bringing the data and operational perspective of the area to broader business initiatives.


Well, what will the requirements be?

Mandatory


Solid SQL and Python (PySpark) — you can write and debug queries and scripts independently.
Proficiency in the Microsoft environment, particularly Excel, SharePoint and Power Automate.
Experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Autonomy and problem-solving mindset: the ability to take a loosely defined brief, find a way forward and propose solutions without constant guidance.
Genuine interest in the business context, not just the data — you ask why something is being requested and what it will be used for before diving into execution.
Working level of English for day-to-day collaboration within an international team.
Spanish (working level) for collaborating directly with the local Customer Care team.


Nice to Have:


Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n or similar platforms.


What do we offer?


Language platform
Wellbeing programme
Flexible working hours
Online platform for lifelong learning
Competitive salary
Flexible remuneration services can be contracted


Why join us?

At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination.


CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations.
OWN IT: We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions.
DARE TO DISRUPT: We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together.
MAKE IT HAPPEN: We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and move forward with Smart execution.
WIN TOGETHER: We achieve great results through collaboration, recognition, and a shared winning mindset.


Inclusive Culture

At InPost, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives strengthen our teams and drive better results.

InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, as it is focused on promotion, within and outside the company, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)

Title: Data Analyst / Data Engineer (Commercial Insurance)
Description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at TDC: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich!

First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations.

What Can You Expect

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative thinker, interested in shaping the future of one of the world’s largest insurers? Do you have a passion for uncovering insights from data and transforming them into actionable business solutions? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our global Commercial Insurance team.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked.

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer you will have the opportunity to:


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Analyse complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that drive business performance.
Develop clear reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings and support decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement improvements based on your analysis.
Ensure data quality and integrity across various sources and processes.
Work alongside experts in various technological domains.
Enhance your skills with real-world experience
Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity.


What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!


Professional experience working with data— exposure to data engineering concepts.
Proficient using SQL for querying and data manipulation, good understanding of query optimization and indexing, whether in RDBMS or big data environments.
Experience with cloud-based technology and solution design: e.g., experience with Microsoft Azure Products, Databricks.
Familiarity with scripting languages, such as Python, Scala or R.
Hands-on experience across different stages of the data lifecycle—from data gathering and cleaning to visualization and reporting.
Interest or experience in applying AI and machine learning techniques, particularly in natural language processing or text analytics.
Previous experience in insurance is an advantage.
A can-do attitude, focused on delivering valuable, user-friendly solutions tailored to specific business challenges.
Eagerness to solve real business problems, with the persistence to see your recommendations through to implementation.
Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English; additional European languages are a plus.


And… What Makes Us Special?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus, we offer:


To support your work-life balance, we have adopted a flexible working model.
Over 300 euros to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.
Wide range of internal and external trainings, including English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs.
Ticket restaurant and Health Insurance with the flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.
Life and accident insurance.
Collective Life retirement Plan
2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you to the company.
Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts
Functional diversity benefits
Different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more
Stock options and mortgage benefits.


Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Bac de Roda.

We Are Waiting for You.

Can you see yourself in this role? Don’t wait any longer! Apply by sending your CV in English.

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share my contact details with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

ServiZurich – Your Talent, Our Strength

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!

Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet.

Remote working: Hybrid
Schedule: Full Time

Title: Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst, you work on global transformation and optimizing projects in Supply Chain. You contribute to successful project outcomes by focusing on the end-to-end data roadmap, from data querying and data quality review to data analysis, dashboarding, data modelling and communication with client business and IT teams.

In This Role You Will


Support master data management and data governance activities, including data preparation, validation, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
Query, analyse and model supply chain data, and review data quality across large datasets.
Support data architecture and integration between ERP, APS and reporting environments, including data migration, data factories and data warehousing.
Create dashboards and analyses that translate data into business insights.
Work closely with project teams, client business and IT teams, and support workshops to gather data requirements and promote best practices.


Job Requirements

About you


3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, data consulting or a related field, preferably working with large datasets from ERP or APS systems. Experience with OMP, Kinaxis or S/4HANA is a plus.
You have good proficiency in data querying, analysis and dashboard creation using tools such as MS Excel, PowerQuery, SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or QlikView.
You are familiar with master data management, data governance best practices, data factories, data architecture and integration.
You have strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and an understanding of the business and customer context.
You have persuasive communication skills, are comfortable working with clients and can prioritize workload and communicate progress in a fast-paced international environment.
You like to learn and develop, are curious about how AI can improve data quality and integration, and are willing to stay hands-on with traditional master data work.
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, are fluent in English and are willing to travel globally and work in a hybrid setup from Barcelona. Spanish is a plus.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together move fast and be kind!


Why join us?


You join a company built around supply chain transformation rather than broad, generalist consulting.
You become part of our supply chain data community, with different growth paths depending on what you want to deepen: data analysis, data quality, data modelling, data architecture, dashboarding, or people and process focused work.
You work on international supply chain projects where you do not only analyse data, but also help structure, cleanse, model, integrate and visualize it.
You leverage your expertise in a pioneering role, with the full support of our international team of supply chain and data experts to drive Barcelona’s success.
You are part of a global network spanning Belgium, the USA, Switzerland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Australia and Singapore, working on impactful international projects.
You have opportunities to travel to client sites, making your work truly international and engaging across borders.
You work on data that directly supports supply chain decisions, transformation projects and the successful implementation of planning solutions.
You work in a flexible and hybrid environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
You benefit from a competitive salary package.


About us

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Within the Supply Chain Plan business unit, we have built up specific expertise in three main areas: Life sciences/pharma, CPG&CH and Chemicals&Industries. In these industries, we support a range of global leaders in their E2E planning transformation journey such as Bayer, Johnson&Johnson, BASF and Bridgestone.

During these E2E supply chain planning transformations, our experts support our customers in every step of their journey. We partner up to define a vision and review the operating model to create a strong and agile basis for the future.

The Plan business unit designs & implements our customers’ business transformation by defining the future organizational operating model, designing new ways of working & solutions advanced planning systems (APS), feeding their data factory, accelerating their setup towards agile S&OP or guiding them through their end-to-end supply chain planning. We do not work for them but rather with them, and we stand by their side the entire time. That is the only way to make changes stick and flourish.

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)

Title: Data & Yield Analyst
Description:
About Softonic

At Softonic, people come first. We’re a multicultural team passionate about building digital experiences used by millions of users worldwide. Guided by a fail fast, learn faster mindset, we encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement, to make a real impact.

Our culture is shaped by four principles:


Step up: Take ownership and act with integrity.
Work smart: Focus on impact and efficiency.
One team: Collaborate openly and support each other.
Think big: Stay curious and challenge the status quo.


Team up with us to grow your career in an international, collaborative, and people-focused company where your ideas matter and your work reaches a global audience.

About The Role

We are a global premium publisher with 28 years of history, providing quality software & APPs download services across multiple languages, also expanding with white labels (Download.com Filehippo), Publisher network (rev.amp), and more partnerships on the way.

As our data & yield analyst reporting to the Director of Advertising, you will be responsible for bridging all revenue team’s data-analytics need (including but not limited to datasets, data visualization, and automation with the process for revenue generation/optimization purposes) with our BI team, to drive initiatives that will boost making more & better data-driven decisions and improve efficiency on revenue generation. Will also take the yield function to analyze market trends & discover business opportunities, not only providing insights to the relevant teams (Sales, Paid, Partnership, Adtech, Product, Traffic, etc) but also following through with the implementation of the initiatives to ensure the business impact is realized.

Key Responsibilities


Be a data champion inside the Advertising & RevOps team and the go-to-person for ithe team & stakeholders from other revenue teams when it comes to better utilization of our data.
Help revenue teams to identify opportunities: using new data points, visualization and automation solutions and ideas to improve revenue generation efficiency, take those requirements, coordinate with dev (BI or other teams) to build the roadmap for the projects & implement accordingly.
Oversee & analyze mid-long (monthly, quarterly, YoY) term yield performance/trends of revenue streams & devices, provide insights on fluctuation, alerts when needed, and recommend a clear plan of action.
Provide A/B test or lean test analysis with recommendations for revenue-related initiatives.
Manage UPR optimisation and automation of pricing recommendation tool (either 3rd party or in-house).
Be able to use agentic AI tools to automate process & streamline data processing & analytic flows to deliver results efficiently
Provide insights on market trends, opportunities, and inventory availability information to the sales & AMs team for better usage of market data
Help teams turn data into actionable insights that unlock revenue opportunities and support smarter business decisions.


Must have


At least 2 years of working experience working as business analyst, preferably with experience in digital advertising business.
Experience of working with BI platforms, like Tableau, Qlikview & advance skills of Google Analytics.
Experience of doing data analysis work with AI tools like Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, etc.
Experience of working with BigQuery, SQL & Python.
Preferable background on big data, data science related topics.
Experience building analytical models and working with structured and unstructured data sets to drive business decisions.
Knowledge of the online advertising ecosystem.
Basic understanding of budgeting, financial forecast, and accounting principles is preferred.
Excellent communication and project management skills with a strong business acumen.
Ability to work on own initiative in a fast-moving environment.
High level of motivation, determination and commitment.
An excellent command of both written and spoken English is required.


Why Softonic?


Private Health Care
Hybrid Work Model (3 days on-site per week in Poblenou area)
Flexible remote work options during certain periods of the year
Flexible Spending Plan & Free Tax Consultant
Learning & Development: Language Classes (English, Spanish, Catalan) and Training Program
Workplace Amenities: Dining Room, Gaming Room, Terraces, and complimentary fresh fruit, coffee, snacks, and drinks
Team & Social Events: Pizza & Beers every Thursday
Lifestyle Benefits: Discounts at gyms and restaurants
Additional Time Off: Birthday leave
Opt for: Mac or Windows laptop
Wellhub program

We are a global premium publisher with 28 years of history, providing quality software & APPs download services across multiple languages, also expanding with white labels (Download.com Filehippo), Publisher network (rev.amp), and more partnerships on the way.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the 12-months role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Title: Controller Data Analyst – Global Operations Controlling
Place: El Prat de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
G+D es un grupo tecnológico internacional de origen alemán, con más de 160 años de historia y presencia global. Nuestras soluciones hacen más seguros los pagos, las comunicaciones y las interacciones digitales que millones de personas utilizan cada día.




Buscamos incorporar un/a Controller a nuestro equipo de Global Operations Controlling en El Prat de Llobregat.




Si te interesa combinar Controlling, análisis de negocio y tecnología, y quieres utilizar los datos para mejorar la toma de decisiones y transformar la forma de trabajar de Finance, este puede ser tu próximo reto.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Darás soporte al Head of Global OPS Controlling, proporcionando análisis e información financiera de valor para la toma de decisiones y contribuyendo a desarrollar una función de Controlling cada vez más digital, automatizada y data-driven.




En tu día a día:

Participarás en cierres, presupuesto y forecast, realizando análisis de desviaciones entre actuals y planificación.
Analizarás costes, márgenes, rentabilidad y KPIs financieros y operativos, identificando riesgos y oportunidades.
Consolidarás el reporting financiero y análisis para management y stakeholders internacionales.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards en Power BI, automatizando procesos de reporting.
Trabajarás con diferentes fuentes de información utilizando Power Query, DAX y SQL.
Desarrollarás y mantendrás modelos de datos, asegurando su calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad.
Participarás en proyectos de automatización, digitalización y mejora continua dentro de Finance & Operations.




¿Qué buscamos?

Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
2-5 años de experiencia en Controlling, análisis financiero o reporting.
Experiencia avanzada con Power BI, DAX y Power Query.
Conocimientos de SQL y modelado de datos.
Nivel avanzado de Excel, incluyendo macros.
Experiencia trabajando con SAP u otros ERP.
Buen nivel de inglés para trabajar en un entorno internacional.

Y, sobre todo, buscamos una persona analítica, proactiva y orientada a resultados, capaz de convertir datos complejos en conclusiones claras y propuestas de mejora.




Será un plus si tienes...

Experiencia en multinacionales o proyectos de automatización financiera, certificaciones Power BI o conocimientos de Microsoft Fabric, Python, Power Automate, ETL o Data Warehouse.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido y plan de formación anual.
Modelo híbrido con 2 días de home office. Jornada intensiva de verano.
Flexibilidad horaria: L-J 8:30-17:30 h y V 8:30-15:30 h, con una hora de flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
Retribución flexible: seguro médico, transporte, guardería y formación.
Parking y comedor de empresa subvencionado.
Un entorno internacional donde podrás trabajar en la intersección entre Finance, Operations y Data Analytics.

📍 El Prat de Llobregat, con acceso en transporte público (L10 ZAL | Riu Vell y diferentes líneas de autobús).




¿Te interesa evolucionar hacia un Controlling más digital y basado en datos? Queremos conocerte.




___

The personal data you provide will be processed to manage your application in accordance with the GDPR and our Privacy Policy, available at Data Privacy | G+D.

Title: Workforce Insights Analyst
Description:
About Ricoh

A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes’ World’s Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People Transform When They Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing

As part of the Workforce Insights team, this role partners with the business to create and develop the core set of workforce and talent data KPIs. The primary focus is to support the business with reporting, collect and interpret data to provide actionable insights, and translate reporting requirements into KPI tracking and dashboards.


Manage, prioritise, and deliver new insight requests from the business across the EMEA region.
Collect, analyse, and interpret workforce data to provide insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and strategic planning.
Translate business reporting requirements into standardized reporting, KPI tracking, and dashboard processes.
Implement and uphold business intelligence policies, including data definitions, data quality, and analytics standards.
Provide specialist advice on the interpretation of HR data, resolving queries and clearly explaining insights to stakeholders.
Maintain and create scalable workforce data models within Microsoft Fabric to establish a structured reporting foundation.
Working across Excel, PowerBI and Microsoft Fabric to create meaningful and impactful dashboards, insights and charts as required by the business




You will ideally have

We're looking for a data-driven professional who is passionate about transforming complex workforce data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making. You will combine strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate compelling data stories to senior stakeholders across the business.

Key Skills & Experience


Proven experience in HR Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with the ability to turn complex workforce data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including the development of robust DAX measures, dashboards, and reports that drive business performance.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including data preparation, modelling, visualisation, and workspace management.
Strong understanding of data analytics, data architecture, and reporting best practices.
Demonstrated ability to identify trends, solve complex business problems, and drive continuous process improvement through data-led solutions.
Knowledge of data modelling, systems thinking, risk analysis, and business process optimisation.
Experience working with large, multicultural organisations and engaging effectively with senior leadership teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence audiences at all levels.
Strong planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing demands.
Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment undergoing change.
Exposure to programming, automation, machine learning, or AI technologies would be advantageous.


Qualifications


Ideally educated to Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or another quantitative discipline. With studies in Finance, Economics, Human Resources, or related fields also considered, providing there is also strong technical expertise in business intelligence, data modelling, and analytics.




In return for your commitment, you can expect

At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.

Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.

Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.

Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.

Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.

Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.

We are an equal opportunities employer

We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

Title: Sales Performance Analyst
Description:
CELSA es el primer productor europeo de acero circular de bajas emisiones y constituye la cadena de suministro circular más grande de Europa. Recicla chatarra férrica para producir acero en hornos de arco eléctrico, usando la tecnología más sostenible y la más eficiente energéticamente.




Buscamos un perfil analítico sólido para incorporarse al área de Control Comercial y Business Performance, dando soporte directo al análisis de ventas, rentabilidad y performance del Grupo a nivel departamental, comité de dirección y consejo de administración, ubicado en nuestras oficinas centrales en Castellbisbal (Barcelona).




El rol está orientado exclusivamente a la generación de análisis estructurados, consistentes y accionables para la toma de decisiones de negocio en un entorno industrial complejo, con alto volumen de datos y múltiples fuentes de información.




Se requiere una persona con criterio analítico contrastado, elevada autonomía real en el tratamiento del dato y experiencia previa trabajando en entornos corporativos exigentes, donde la calidad del análisis es crítica para la toma de decisiones.




Tus funciones serán:




1. Análisis de performance comercial

Análisis de ventas por Unidad de Negocio (volumen, precio, mix y margen).
Seguimiento, explicación y consolidación de desviaciones vs presupuesto, forecast y cierre.
Identificación de drivers reales de evolución del negocio.
Contribución al análisis de rentabilidad y evolución del EBITDA.




2. Análisis de mercado y entorno competitivo

Recopilación, estructuración y análisis de información de mercado (precios, competencia, importaciones, share).
Elaboración de análisis comparativos entre mercados y competidores.
Identificación de cambios relevantes en el entorno competitivo y su impacto en negocio.
Transformación de datos en insights accionables para Dirección Comercial.




3. Control de actividad comercial y calidad del dato

Análisis de actividad comercial y productividad por equipo.
Control riguroso de coherencia, calidad y trazabilidad del dato en CRM y sistemas comerciales.
Identificación de inconsistencias relevantes en información comercial.
Soporte analítico a decisiones de pricing, mix y cross-selling.




4. Reporting financiero-comercial

Preparación de información para cierres mensuales comerciales.
Análisis de EBITDA, márgenes y KPIs comerciales clave.
Construcción y mantenimiento de cuadros de mando comerciales.
Asegurar consistencia total, trazabilidad y fiabilidad del dato utilizado en reporting ejecutivo.




5. Automatización, digitalización e inteligencia de datos (Advanced Analytics & AI)

Evolución y optimización de procesos de reporting y análisis con foco en eficiencia y escalabilidad.
Participación en la automatización de reporting y eliminación de tareas manuales de bajo valor.
Evolución de herramientas de Business Intelligence y modelos de datos comerciales.
Aplicación de analítica avanzada para:
detección de anomalías relevantes en ventas, precios y márgenes
identificación de patrones de comportamiento comercial con impacto en negocio
mejora de calidad de forecast mediante análisis histórico y señales de datos
Colaboración con IT en la mejora del modelo de datos, gobierno del dato y calidad de la información.




Perfil que requerimos:

Grado en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Estadística o similar.
3–5 años de experiencia real y demostrable en: control comercial, business performance / FP&A, sales analytics en entorno industrial o corporativo complejo
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos, múltiples sistemas y fuentes heterogéneas.
Alta capacidad analítica con pensamiento estructurado y orientado a negocio (no solo reporting).
Nivel alto de Excel (uso avanzado real en análisis, no reporting básico).
Experiencia en herramientas de BI (Power BI u otras equivalentes).
Uso habitual de CRM y sistemas corporativos de reporting (SAP valorable).
Inglés alto en entorno profesional internacional.
Capacidad demostrada de trabajar con autonomía en análisis complejos sin necesidad de supervisión detallada.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Queremos que la persona que se incorpore haga carrera con nosotros, por ello, ofrecemos un contrato indefinido.
Formación continua subvencionada por la empresa.
Clases de idiomas gratuitas.
Acceso a la plataforma LinkedIn Learning.
Trabajar en una importante multinacional del sector industria.
Comedor de empresa con el 50% del coste subvencionado.
Teletrabajo 6 días/mes.
Parking en las instalaciones.
Otros beneficios sociales con ahorros fiscales: cheques gourmet, seguro de salud, formaciones...
Salario a determinar en función del perfil y experiencia de lxs candidatxs.

El rol está orientado exclusivamente a la generación de análisis estructurados, consistentes y accionables para la toma de decisiones de negocio en un entorno industrial complejo, con alto volumen de datos y múltiples fuentes de información.


Se requiere una persona con criterio analítico contrastado, elevada autonomía real en el tratamiento del dato y experiencia previa trabajando en entornos corporativos exigentes, donde la calidad del análisis es crítica para la toma de decisiones.


Tus funciones serán:


1. Análisis de performance comercial

  • Análisis de ventas por Unidad de Negocio (volumen, precio, mix y margen).
  • Seguimiento, explicación y consolidación de desviaciones vs presupuesto, forecast y cierre.
  • Identificación de drivers reales de evolución del negocio.
  • Contribución al análisis de rentabilidad y evolución del EBITDA.


2. Análisis de mercado y entorno competitivo

  • Recopilación, estructuración y análisis de información de mercado (precios, competencia, importaciones, share).
  • Elaboración de análisis comparativos entre mercados y competidores.
  • Identificación de cambios relevantes en el entorno competitivo y su impacto en negocio.
  • Transformación de datos en insights accionables para Dirección Comercial.


3. Control de actividad comercial y calidad del dato

  • Análisis de actividad comercial y productividad por equipo.
  • Control riguroso de coherencia, calidad y trazabilidad del dato en CRM y sistemas comerciales.
  • Identificación de inconsistencias relevantes en información comercial.
  • Soporte analítico a decisiones de pricing, mix y cross-selling.


4. Reporting financiero-comercial

  • Preparación de información para cierres mensuales comerciales.
  • Análisis de EBITDA, márgenes y KPIs comerciales clave.
  • Construcción y mantenimiento de cuadros de mando comerciales.
  • Asegurar consistencia total, trazabilidad y fiabilidad del dato utilizado en reporting ejecutivo.


5. Automatización, digitalización e inteligencia de datos (Advanced Analytics & AI)

  • Evolución y optimización de procesos de reporting y análisis con foco en eficiencia y escalabilidad.
  • Participación en la automatización de reporting y eliminación de tareas manuales de bajo valor.
  • Evolución de herramientas de Business Intelligence y modelos de datos comerciales.
  • Aplicación de analítica avanzada para:
  • detección de anomalías relevantes en ventas, precios y márgenes
  • identificación de patrones de comportamiento comercial con impacto en negocio
  • mejora de calidad de forecast mediante análisis histórico y señales de datos
  • Colaboración con IT en la mejora del modelo de datos, gobierno del dato y calidad de la información.


Perfil que requerimos:

  • Grado en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Estadística o similar.
  • 3–5 años de experiencia real y demostrable en: control comercial, business performance / FP&A, sales analytics en entorno industrial o corporativo complejo
  • Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos, múltiples sistemas y fuentes heterogéneas.
  • Alta capacidad analítica con pensamiento estructurado y orientado a negocio (no solo reporting).
  • Nivel alto de Excel (uso avanzado real en análisis, no reporting básico).
  • Experiencia en herramientas de BI (Power BI u otras equivalentes).
  • Uso habitual de CRM y sistemas corporativos de reporting (SAP valorable).
  • Inglés alto en entorno profesional internacional.
  • Capacidad demostrada de trabajar con autonomía en análisis complejos sin necesidad de supervisión detallada.


¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Queremos que la persona que se incorpore haga carrera con nosotros, por ello, ofrecemos un contrato indefinido.
  • Formación continua subvencionada por la empresa.
  • Clases de idiomas gratuitas.
  • Acceso a la plataforma LinkedIn Learning.
  • Trabajar en una importante multinacional del sector industria.
  • Comedor de empresa con el 50% del coste subvencionado.

  • Parking en las instalaciones.
