Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.

At Ogury, our vision unites us all . But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different , creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe , has access to the same opportunities , and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

Together we’re changing the face of adtech with values that inspire excellence, standards that encourage a leadership mindset, and an inclusive workplace where Ogurians are engaged and know they belong .

Working at Ogury

At Ogury , we pledge to provide all our team members with an equitable voice across our company and community. We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected , and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Senior Data Analyst to specialize in our advertising platform reporting and analytics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between data and execution, supporting our Product and Client Services teams by building scalable, automated reporting solutions.

As a key member of our Global Analytics Team, you will look beyond daily reporting to champion data governance, data quality, and scalable data modeling. You will collaborate closely with Data Reporting and Platform Engineering teams, utilizing dbt to build robust, reliable data models that serve as the foundation for global business decisions.

Why you'll love this role

  • Build systems that scale — Design and own automated reporting solutions that serve the entire organization; move beyond ad-hoc analysis to engineer production-grade data models with dbt that become the trusted foundation for critical business decisions
  • Work with a modern analytics stack — Partner with top-tier data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse) and best-in-class tools; solve complex optimization problems with large-scale clickstream and transactional datasets while championing data governance standards across a global team
  • Drive impact across the business — Act as the analytical bridge between Product, Client Services, and Platform Engineering; translate your insights into tangible outcomes that optimize ad revenue, improve user experience, and directly influence how the platform evolves

What You Will Be Doing

  • Ad Platform Reporting & Scalability: Design, develop, and scale automated dashboards and analytics solutions that provide deep insights into ad platform performance, campaign delivery, and user engagement for both Product and Client Services teams.
  • Global Data Governance & Quality: Serve as a core member of the Global Analytics team, leading initiatives to define data standards, enforce data quality checks, and document data lineages to ensure a trusted, single source of truth.
  • Data Modeling with dbt: Partner with Data Reporting and Platform teams to build, maintain, and optimize production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring efficient transformations and analytics-ready datasets.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the analytical partner to Product Managers (to guide feature development) and Client Services (to provide scalable client-facing insights and automate ad-hoc requests).
  • Advanced Analytics & Insights: Go beyond standard metrics to uncover trends, identify platform inefficiencies, and provide actionable recommendations that optimize ad revenue and user experience.

What You Will Bring To Ogury

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Analytics Engineering, ideally within an AdTech
  • Data Modeling & dbt: Proven hands-on experience using dbt to develop, test, and deploy scalable data models in a cloud data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse).
  • SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, including writing highly optimized, complex queries and managing large-scale, clickstream, or transactional datasets.
  • Scalable BI & Visualization: Advanced proficiency in building scalable, intuitive dashboards in modern BI tools (e.g.Omni, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) tailored for both internal product tracking and external client services.
  • Data Governance Focus: Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, data governance principles, and version control (Git).
  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical metrics into scalable solutions for product teams and business clients.

How Ogury Supports You

At Ogury, we believe in taking care of our team members and providing a work environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

While benefits may vary by location, here’s a glimpse of what you can typically expect when you join our team:

  • A competitive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits coverage
  • Meal voucher
  • Holiday and leave allowance, in addition to national holidays
  • A strong focus on the well-being of our team members, with access to both physical and mental health resources
  • Flexible Working Model: At Ogury, we believe in the power of presence to fuel innovation. Our hybrid approach is centered on two core in-office collaboration days to drive team synergy, plus one additional office day of your choosing to support personal balance. This 3-day baseline ensures strong connection and real-time problem-solving, while allowing for flexibility across the rest of the week.
  • And more

We thank you in advance for your interest in Ogury!

Our Commitment

At Ogury, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace by providing equal employment opportunities to all. We will consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

We are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact us. In accordance with applicable laws, we will work with you to provide reasonable support and ensure a fair hiring process.

Please note that this position is for an existing vacancy and is open to all qualified candidates.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Description:

Location:

Contract
Permanent, full-time
About Us
devicenow offers Device as a Service for workplace IT hardware on a global scale. We revolutionize the Device as a Service industry – the only thing missing is you!
At devicenow, we believe that people create the essence of a company, shaping its culture with every interaction, idea, and shared experience. We are searching for talented individuals who can bring a blend of passion and expertise to our team and help us shape the future of devicenow.
Join us to become a part of an ambitious team of change-makers and build a fulfilling career with us.

In this job advertisement, the masculine form is used throughout. In accordance with the General Act on Equal Treatment, these designations are not to be regarded as gender-specific.

Your role in the team
Your role in the team is to serve as the link between business departments and the company's data ecosystem, transforming data into reliable insights that support informed decision making.
Your Responsibilities

Act as the bridge between our business departments and our data landscape (databases, data warehouse, Power BI).
Analyze data across operational systems, the data warehouse and Power BI reports to answer business questions.
Work closely with specialists in the business units to understand their processes, KPIs and reporting needs.
Review existing reports for plausibility and correctness, and propose improvements or redesigns.
Translate business requirements into clear specifications and discuss them on eye level with our developers and data architects.
Document data sources, calculation logic and report definitions.

What We Expect From You

Solid experience analysing business data and working with BI tools, ideally Power BI.
Strong SQL skills and a good understanding of relational databases and typical data warehouse structures.
Ability to read and reverse-engineer existing reports and data models to identify issues.
Structured, analytical mindset with a sharp eye for inconsistencies in numbers.
Strong communication skills: able to engage with business specialists (Operations, Sales, Service, etc.) as well as technical discussions with developers.
Curiosity to understand business processes rather than being a domain expert from day one.
Fluent English; German or Spanish is a plus.

What Devicenow Can Offer You

Be part of a rapidly expanding industry and take advantage of unique career opportunities.
Investment in your growth and skill acquisition through comprehensive onboarding, training, and career advancement opportunities.
Flexible hybrid working model – work from home or office, visit our offices around the world.
Enjoy a competitive salary package.
Regular team and company social events.
Flexible benefits package: choose between meal vouchers, a Wellhub membership, or a combination of both.
Optional private health insurance through tax-efficient payroll deductions (salary sacrifice).


Apply now!

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Senior Fullstack Data Analyst (Commercial Analytics)
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

Please note: applications will be open until Friday 2nd October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.

We will not review any applications before the closing window so please don't rush and take the time you need to submit a high quality application.

Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine from acquisition, retention and, propensity modelling to customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions.

As a Senior Full Stack Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of commercial analytics and customer intelligence. You build end-to-end analytics solutions (retention models, growth analyses, activation funnels, and GTM dashboards) that directly influence how Pleo acquires, onboards, retains, and grows its customer base.

Who you'll work with

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner primarily with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams. You will also work closely with the onboarding and self-serve product teams as well as colleagues across Growth Intelligence and the broader data community, including Data Scientists in your team and Analytics Engineers who own the modelling layer your analysis depends on.

For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally.

What you'll be doing


Build and maintain the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention: propensity models, growth dashboards, activation funnels, and the commercial reporting GTM teams depend on day-to-day.
Partner with Customer Experience, Sales, and Success teams to understand their data needs and deliver dashboards and analyses that drive operational decisions.
Conduct in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns to surface trends, risks, and growth opportunities (owning the insight and narrative, not just the output).
Support the onboarding and self-serve product teams with data on activation, engagement, and friction, translating product behaviour into insights that improve the customer journey.
Design and analyse experiments to test growth hypotheses and optimise key commercial metrics within Pleo's experimentation methodology, ensuring statistical rigour.
Build analytics explicitly designed for self-serve and AI access
Contribute metric definitions and domain knowledge to the semantic layer, working with Data Services & Governance to ensure GTM metrics are consistently defined across BI tools and AI tooling.
Engage with data colleagues across Intelligence to share knowledge, maintain standards, and contribute to a culture of craft.


What you bring


Proven experience working across both insights generation and analytics engineering in a SaaS environment (fintech is a big plus).
Solid proficiency with Python, SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested models, understand layered architecture, can manipulate and analyse data to uncover insights.
BigQuery experience, including complex transformations and performance considerations.
BI tool proficiency such as Looker and LookML
Commercial mindset: you understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle stages, and how data connects to revenue outcomes.
Strong data visualisation skills: you build dashboards that GTM stakeholders actually use, not just ones that look good.
Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and know why metric consistency matters as AI tooling scales.
Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code.
Strong ownership and delivery discipline: you manage multiple projects with close attention to detail and follow through.
Solid understanding of data contracts: schema agreements, ownership, and SLAs between data producers and downstream consumers.


This role is not a good fit if


You prefer to specialise deeply in one area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between analysis, analytics engineering, experimentation, and stakeholder management.
You are not comfortable engaging directly with demanding commercial stakeholders and translating their needs into data solutions without a fully defined brief. You'll often need to shape the question as much as answer it.
You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex. Definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires negotiation as much as analysis.


Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have built things that GTM teams are actively relying on.


Growth Intelligence's core analytics layer: activation funnels, customer health reporting, retention signals will be in better shape than when you arrived. You'll know which models and dashboards matter most, where the gaps are, and have fixed at least some of them in ways that reduce manual work for RevOps, CS, and CX.
You'll have contributed real metric definitions to the semantic layer, agreed with Data Services & Governance on what canonical GTM metrics actually are, and made that stick downstream. Analysts and AI tools will be getting consistent answers rather than each team maintaining their own version.
You'll have a genuine working relationship with the commercial stakeholders you serve — RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success — and they'll have a clear sense of what to bring to you and what to expect back.
And you'll have shipped at least one piece of analysis or tooling that changed a commercial decision or enabled something that wasn't possible before, not just improved the plumbing, but unlocked actual use.


Show Me The Benefits


Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
An async core skills test assessing your SQL fundamentals
Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge and technical experience.
Pleo Challenge: A live technical case interview designed to assess your technical expertise around data modeling, manipulation and insights generation.


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

  • You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex. Definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires negotiation as much as analysis.

Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have built things that GTM teams are actively relying on.

  • Growth Intelligence's core analytics layer: activation funnels, customer health reporting, retention signals will be in better shape than when you arrived. You'll know which models and dashboards matter most, where the gaps are, and have fixed at least some of them in ways that reduce manual work for RevOps, CS, and CX.
  • You'll have contributed real metric definitions to the semantic layer, agreed with Data Services & Governance on what canonical GTM metrics actually are, and made that stick downstream. Analysts and AI tools will be getting consistent answers rather than each team maintaining their own version.
  • You'll have a genuine working relationship with the commercial stakeholders you serve — RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success — and they'll have a clear sense of what to bring to you and what to expect back.
  • And you'll have shipped at least one piece of analysis or tooling that changed a commercial decision or enabled something that wasn't possible before, not just improved the plumbing, but unlocked actual use.

Show Me The Benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
  • An async core skills test assessing your SQL fundamentals
  • Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute experience-based interview to deep dive into your domain knowledge and technical experience.
  • Pleo Challenge: A live technical case interview designed to assess your technical expertise around data modeling, manipulation and insights generation.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

About Your Application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Power BI Analyst
Description:
#SomosAltia

Altia somos un equipo de 4.000 profesionales que creamos soluciones digitales preparadas para el futuro, capaces de generar valor real y provocar cambios significativos.

Repartidos en más de 30 localizaciones de 10 países, sumamos nuestra energía aplicando nuestra visión innovadora de la tecnología a proyectos para más de 1.000 organizaciones que son motores del cambio.

Llevamos 30 años con un propósito: crecer haciendo crecer, y hacerlo, además, de forma sostenible y duradera. Tenemos claro que solo seremos importantes si juntos aportamos un impacto positivo y todos evolucionamos en el proceso.

Queremos estar siempre cerca de nuestros clientes, evolucionando juntos y aprovechando al máximo las oportunidades.

Un/a Analista de Power BI que quiera unirse al equipo de uno de nuestros clientes del sector financiero, con proyección internacional y entorno de trabajo francófono.

Creación, mantenimiento y evolución de cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI

Proyecto de alto impacto

Remuneración flexible con Paquete retributivo

Persona analítica, resolutiva y autónoma, con buena capacidad de comunicación y orientación a negocio

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Sales (All Genders)
Description:
Company Description

With over 25 years’ experience, plus the same enormous passion and ambition we had on day-one, we’re trailblazers in the pet e-commerce industry. Our solutions make over 12 million customers genuinely happier – and that’s something we really care about. We work together to continually adapt; embracing change and the challenges it brings so that we can keep doing better. Join us and discover a place where your potential meets your passion for pets. That’s the power of plus.

Job Description

As a Senior Sales Analyst at zooplus, you will join our Shopping & Markets Analytics team within the Data & Analytics division acting as a strategic analytics partner for our Regional Sales and Commercial teams across Europe.

You will own a portfolio of analytical products, reporting solutions and business insights that support commercial decision-making across multiple markets and functions. Working closely with Sales, Growth / Category managers, Pricing and Leadership stakeholders, you will identify growth opportunities, challenge assumptions, drive KPI governance and provide actionable recommendations that drive business performance and support the future growth of zooplus.

Shopping & Markets Analytics mission

The Shopping & Markets Analytics team empowers product and business teams to make better decisions by transforming transactional and behavioral data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

We partner closely with stakeholders across the full commercial lifecycle, from performance analysis and opportunity identification to impact assessment and business steering. By combining business understanding with advanced analytics, we help teams unlock growth opportunities, accelerate decision-making and foster a strong data-driven culture across zooplus.

Key Responsibilities


Act as a strategic analytics partner for Regional Sales stakeholders across Europe, supporting data-driven decision-making and business growth.
Identify commercial opportunities and performance drivers through in-depth analysis of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and market trends.
Own and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and KPI frameworks that support business steering and performance monitoring.
Design and maintain scalable analytical datasets and data marts, ensuring reliable and efficient access to business insights.
Lead complex analytical projects in collaboration with cross-functional teams including Sales, Pricing, CRM, Category Management and Data Science.
Leverage AI, automation and modern analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and enable self-service analytics.
Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
Promote a data-driven culture by helping stakeholders understand, access and act on data.


Qualifications

Skills and experience:


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related analytical field.
5+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Commercial analytics roles, preferably within e-commerce, retail or digital businesses.
Advanced SQL expertise, including large-scale data analysis, query optimization and development of analytical datasets.
Strong experience with Tableau, Power BI or similar BI and data visualization tools.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of sales, pricing, promotions, customer behavior and e-commerce performance metrics.
Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and influence stakeholder decisions.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior business stakeholders.
Experience working with cloud-based analytics environments and modern data platforms.
Proactive, business-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Strong prioritization skills and the ability to adapt quickly to evolving business needs and stakeholder priorities.


Nice to Have


Experience working with digital behavioral or event-based data and translating customer interactions into actionable business insights.
Experience with Python or R for analytics, automation or modelling.
Experience building self-service analytics solutions and scalable reporting frameworks.
Experience with forecasting, experimentation or other advanced analytical methodologies.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled analytics tools to improve analytical efficiency and business decision-making.
Experience leading cross-functional analytics initiatives or mentoring other analysts.


Additional Information

Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you’ll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There’s an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you’ll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart. Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our blog posts.

A note on compensation: We believe in being transparent about salary ranges. The range shown reflects the full scope that the role can grow into over time, depending on experience, skills, and impact. Most offers are positioned around the midpoint of the range, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across our teams.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Sobre Twenix

La vida no es listen and repeat. Y el trabajo tampoco.

En Twenix creemos que aprender un idioma no va de memorizar reglas, sino de atreverse a hablar cuando importa: en una reunión, una presentación o una negociación real.

Somos una EdTech B2B que transforma la formación corporativa en idiomas con un enfoque simple, personalized and fun: conversaciones online de 26 minutos pensadas para profesionales que quieren comunicarse con confianza en su día a día y para empresas que no quieren gastar energía en la misma formación de siempre.

Nuestra misión: que la formación en idiomas deje de ser un gasto y se convierta en impacto real para empresas y profesionales. Desde 2017 en inglés y ahora, también en español, francés y portugués.




🎯 Este es tu reto

En Twenix damos servicio a más de 1500 clientes y en 2026 tenemos previsto dar 860.000 clases. Somos una de las scaleups que más crece de España según Deloitte, y en los últimos años hemos multiplicado nuestra facturación x5 y hemos añadido 5 nuevos idiomas a nuestra plataforma. Ahora, buscamos un Data Analyst que nos ayude a liderar el análisis de datos complejos para identificar tendencias, generar insights accionables y apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Impulsarás una cultura data-driven en Twenix, colaborando con Ventas, Producto, Marketing, Operaciones y Finanzas, y reportando al Director de Data.




🧩 Lo que harás:

Liderar proyectos de análisis de datos de principio a fin: desde entender el reto de negocio hasta presentar conclusiones y recomendaciones accionables.
Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para identificar tendencias, oportunidades y palancas de crecimiento, convirtiendo los datos en decisiones que mejoren la eficiencia de Twenix.
Trabajar de forma cercana con equipos de Ventas, Marketing, Producto, Operaciones y Finanzas, entendiendo sus necesidades y diseñando soluciones analíticas que generen impacto.
Garantizar la calidad, integridad y fiabilidad de los datos, detectando y resolviendo posibles problemas.
Comunicar insights de forma clara a diferentes stakeholders, utilizando storytelling y visualizaciones que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y resultados para asegurar un trabajo transparente y reproducible.
Estar al día de nuevas herramientas y tendencias en Data & Analytics, incorporándolas cuando aporten valor.




🔎 Lo que buscamos

Formación en un área cuantitativa: Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía, ADE o similar.
3+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics, BI o posiciones similares, idealmente en entornos internacionales.
Experiencia entendiendo procesos de negocio y transformando el análisis en recomendaciones y planes de acción para mejorar procesos y eficiencia.
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y plataformas cloud como GCP, AWS o Azure, así como con procesos ETL/ELT (valorable experiencia con Dataform).
Dominio de SQL y experiencia con herramientas de programación para análisis de datos (Python o R).
Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Looker, Looker Studio o Tableau.
Conocimiento de metodologías ágiles y gestión de proyectos.
Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de rápido crecimiento.
AI First con aplicación práctica en el entorno de data (Claude, Gemini, Chatgpt)




🤘Nice to have

Una persona curiosa, analítica y orientada a resolver problemas, capaz de ir más allá del dato para encontrar la causa raíz.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y storytelling, tanto en español como en inglés.
Proactividad, autonomía y capacidad para priorizar y avanzar en un entorno dinámico.
Mentalidad de mejora continua y ganas de cuestionar lo establecido y probar nuevas formas de hacer las cosas.
Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes equipos y stakeholders, adaptándose a distintas necesidades.
Experiencia en análisis estadístico será un plus.




🎁 Lo que te ofrecemos

Formato 100% remoto o híbrido si estás en Madrid o Almería.
Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes, verano y Navidad.
26 días laborables de vacaciones 🌴
Día libre en tu cumple 🎉 (sí, nos gusta celebrarlo contigo).
3 días al año para asistir a eventos o formaciones de tu sector. 📝
Clases de idiomas ilimitadas con nuestra propia metodología Twenix. 📖
Plan de bienestar para invertir en tu desarrollo, salud y formación. 🩺
Retribución flexible con Cobee (comida, transporte, formación) y Alan (seguro de salud). 💶
Plataforma de descuentos exclusivos por ser empleados de Twenix.
Excelente clima laboral: compromiso, cercanía y trabajo en equipo. 🍀
Y por supuesto, ¡eventos anuales de team building para disfrutar en compañía! 🤼




💙 Nuestros valores

Foco en lo importante: Buscamos impacto real. Priorizamos lo que aporta valor al negocio, a los clientes y al equipo, y evitamos el ruido, el postureo y el trabajo porque sí.
Crecemos juntos: Creemos en la colaboración, la confianza y la responsabilidad compartida. Aquí se trabaja y se construye en equipo.
Hacer que las cosas pasen: Nos gusta hacer las cosas bien y mejorar constantemente. Somos ambiciosos, aprendemos rápido de los errores y no nos conformamos con el mínimo.
Ideas antes que egos: Fomentamos las conversaciones honestas, el feedback directo y el pensamiento crítico, siempre desde la humildad y las ganas de aprender.




Para la promoción de la igualdad, en nuestra empresa adoptamos la siguiente medida: En igualdad de oportunidades accederá al puesto de promoción la candidata o el candidato del sexo infrarrepresentado, para el puesto donde se ha producido la vacante.

¿Te animas a unirte al cohete Twenix?🚀 Aplica ahora y construyámoslo juntos.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;

Title: Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams based in Spain.

You will work at the intersection of data, product, and machine learning, helping teams turn complex datasets into actionable business and product insights.

Your analysis will support a range of teams working across data science, ranking, recommendations, personalization, AI-powered shopping, search optimization, and retail media.

You will investigate user behavior, identify opportunities, and evaluate how product changes affect both customer experience and business performance.

A key part of the role will be designing experiments, defining meaningful metrics, and using statistical analysis to guide product decisions.

You will work with large-scale datasets using SQL and Python while building dashboards and analytical tools that make data accessible to decision-makers.

The role offers broad exposure to engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where analytical thinking, ownership, clear communication, and measurable impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities


Analyze user behavior and large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, identify issues, and surface opportunities for product and business improvement.
Design, run, and analyze A/B tests to evaluate product changes and quantify their impact on key business metrics.
Define, validate, and monitor metrics that capture both user experience and business outcomes.
Build dashboards, reports, analytical tools, and other data resources that support informed decision-making across multiple teams.
Partner with engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders to translate analytical findings into actionable product improvements.
Investigate product funnels, performance trends, and user behavior to identify opportunities for optimization.
Apply SQL, Python, and distributed data systems to process, explore, and analyze large volumes of data.
Contribute analytical expertise across different domains, which may include data science integrations, ranking, recommendations, AI shopping agents, search optimization, personalization, and retail media.
Help teams understand machine learning-related data, including training data quality, model evaluation, and relevant performance metrics.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly, adapting the level of technical detail to different audiences and stakeholders.
Take ownership of analytical projects from problem definition and investigation through to recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Requirements


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to address business and product questions.
Solid knowledge of SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Professional experience using Python for data analysis, including tools such as pandas, NumPy, and data visualization libraries.
Good understanding of A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, and core statistical concepts.
Experience defining and analyzing product metrics, metric trees, funnels, and other frameworks for measuring product performance.
Understanding of machine learning pipelines, training data quality, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with search relevance, ranking, or recommendation systems is a plus.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and proactively identify opportunities to improve products and processes.
Experience in a customer-facing role is a plus.
Previous experience in e-commerce or product analytics is a plus.


Benefits


Fully remote working environment, giving you flexibility over where you live and work.
Unlimited vacation time, with employees strongly encouraged to take at least 3 weeks per year.
Work-from-home stipend to help you create an effective home-office setup.
Apple laptop provided for new employees.
Annual training and professional development budget.
Maternity and paternity leave for eligible employees.
Opportunity to work with talented and empathetic colleagues while contributing to meaningful, high-impact projects.
Regular team offsite events to connect and collaborate.
Base salary of $80,000–$120,000 USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.
Stock options offered in addition to the base salary.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.




At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognising that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

We review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we find the right candidate. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.




Feel free to get in touch with me at enrique.barajasluque@verisure.es. I’d be happy to tell you more about the role and Verisure!

Title: Senior Digital Data Analyst (Marketing Intelligence)
Description:
Desde Timup, consultora de selección, estamos colaborando con una agencia creativa en la búsqueda de un/a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist, una posición con recorrido hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Buscamos una persona que combine una sólida capacidad analítica con una visión estratégica del marketing y la comunicación. Alguien capaz de transformar datos en recomendaciones de negocio, ayudar a medir el impacto real de las campañas y convertirse en un partner de referencia tanto para clientes como para los equipos internos.

La persona incorporada tendrá un papel clave impulsando una cultura data-driven dentro de la organización, liderando proyectos de medición y contribuyendo a maximizar la efectividad de las estrategias de comunicación.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de analizar el rendimiento de campañas y acciones de comunicación, tanto digitales como offline, convirtiendo los datos en insights que permitan tomar mejores decisiones de negocio. Además, liderarás la interlocución con clientes en todo lo relacionado con analítica y medición, participando activamente en la evolución del área.




Responsabilidades

Analizar el rendimiento de campañas de comunicación y marketing, evaluando su impacto sobre la marca y el negocio.

Diseñar, desarrollar e interpretar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para clientes y equipos internos.

Liderar la relación con clientes en materia de analítica, reporting y medición de resultados.

Integrar información procedente de diferentes fuentes para obtener una visión global del rendimiento de las acciones de marketing.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

Impulsar el uso del análisis de datos como herramienta para mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y la toma de decisiones.

Participar en la evolución de metodologías y procesos de medición dentro de la compañía.




¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Performance Analytics.

Experiencia previa en agencia o en entornos digitales de ritmo dinámico.

Dominio de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau (muy valorable), Power BI, Looker o Qlik.

Conocimientos sólidos de marketing digital, comunicación y medición de campañas.

Experiencia trabajando con SQL, análisis de datos y estadística aplicada.

Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados.

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).




Se valorará especialmente

Conocimientos de Python.

Experiencia con herramientas como Adverity, Supermetrics o Datorama.

Conocimientos de Social Listening (Brandwatch, Lumen/Talkwalker, Pulsar, entre otras).

Uso de herramientas de IA como Claude, Gemini o NotebookLM aplicadas al análisis de datos y automatización de procesos.




¿Qué ofrece la compañía?

Incorporación a una agencia creativa reconocida, con un entorno altamente colaborativo e innovador.

Posición con recorrido profesional y posibilidad de evolucionar hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Horario flexible y jornada intensiva durante el verano.

Plan de retribución flexible.

Acceso a formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

Programas de bienestar y beneficios sociales.

Participación en un entorno donde los datos tienen un papel estratégico en la toma de decisiones y el crecimiento de los clientes.

Title: Global Data Analyst
Description:
The Global Data and Technology team is looking for a candidate for the position of Global Data Analyst. We are looking for a Data Analyst. You will be situated within the product team, the data Engineering team, and working closely with the strategic Media Planning & client experience team. You will deliver Products across multiple regions and clients and support local markets across global initiatives, for optimal cross pollination and maximising the integrated connections between practice and product.

Mission & Responsibilities


Provides the product team with a technical expertise applied to data and solutions.
Automate daily tasks with technical scripting languages.
Translate complex data analysis into clear product logic, insights, and decisions.
Develop media budget allocation tools with deep understanding of reach curves, and scenario modelling.
Perform data analysis to evaluate product outputs.
Partner with data scientists who design and build algorithms, providing analytical framing, validation, and media context.
Use AI‑enabled tools to explore, test, and improve product features and decision frameworks.


Soft Skills & Competencies


5+years of experience in data analysis, ideally within media, advertising, marketing analytics, or related domains.
Strong understanding of media metrics, reach curve analysis, and budget optimisation concepts.
Hands‑on experience with analytical tools (e.g. SQL, Python, R, BI tools).
Comfortable working independently with low stakeholder exposure in an internal, product‑focused environment.
Loves problem solving.
Individual contributor with full ownership of projects.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Description:

We're seeking a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Experiments & Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:


Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
Data cleaning and validation,
Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
Business Proficiency in English,
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

Apply now!

Title: Senior GCP Data Analyst (Valencia)
Description:
Devoteam es una consultora europea líder especializada en estrategia digital, plataformas tecnológicas, ciberseguridad y transformación empresarial a través de la tecnología.

La tecnología forma parte de nuestro ADN, y creemos que actúa como catalizador de un cambio positivo, al tiempo que mantenemos un equilibrio que nos permite ofrecer a nuestra cartera de clientes herramientas tecnológicas de primer nivel, pero siempre con el trato personalizado y la profesionalidad de un equipo que les acompaña en cada paso del camino.

Desde hace más de 30 años, Devoteam se ha comprometido a poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Contamos con más de 11 000 empleados en todo el grupo, repartidos por 25 países de Europa, Oriente Medio y África.

Job Description

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior para incorporarse a un proyecto de larga duración (mínimo 2 años) en un importante cliente referente del Sector de las Telecomunicaciones.

En este rol serás el nexo entre la ingeniería de datos y el negocio, encargándote de estructurar grandes volúmenes de información en Google Cloud Platform, garantizar la calidad del dato y construir la capa semántica de visualización para la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Tus funciones principales:


Consultoría SQL & GCP: Realizar consultas complejas en BigQuery para extraer, limpiar y estructurar grandes datasets del sector telecom.
Capa Semántica y Visualización: Diseñar y mantener la capa semántica en Looker y construir dashboards interactivos e intuitivos en Looker Studio.
Modelado de Negocio & Forecast: Crear modelos analíticos y predicciones alimentados directamente desde BigQuery o Looker.
Optimización y Calidad del Dato: Definir y estructurar tablas optimizadas en BigQuery, asegurando la gobernanza, precisión e integridad de los datos consumidos en Looker o Excel.
Análisis Avanzado: Realizar manipulaciones de datos y análisis estadísticos apoyándote en Excel y consultas SQL avanzadas.
Experiencia: Mínimo 4-5 años trabajando como Data Analyst Senior o Analytics Engineer.
SQL & BigQuery: Dominio avanzado de SQL e historial trabajando con arquitecturas en BigQuery (GCP).
Ecosistema Looker: Experiencia sólida construyendo la capa semántica en Looker y diseñando cuadros de mando en Looker Studio.
Modelado: Habilidad demostrable en modelado de negocio, forecasting y manipulación avanzada en Excel.
Ubicación y Disponibilidad:
Residencia en Valencia: Modelo híbrido (2-3 días/semana en oficina).
Valorable: Experiencia previa previa dentro del sector de Telecomunicaciones.


Additional Information

Información adicional


Proyecto estable: Asignación directa a un proyecto estratégico de largo recorrido (mínimo 2 años).
Certificaciones oficiales: Apoyo y financiación para certificar tus conocimientos en Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Flexibilidad: Modelo de trabajo adaptado a tu residencia y flexibilidad horaria.
Beneficios Sociales: Retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, transporte) y programa de bienestar integral.
